name: Tree Roots Filter Reads The Parent Map

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

primaryTarget: native release build, criterion benches (macOS arm64)
hypothesisMarkdown:
## Tree Roots Filter Reads The Parent Map Hypothesis

### Hypothesis

`transform_to_tree` re-evaluates its predicate for every node on every batch; the built-in roots predicate calls `TreeNode::is_root`, which locks the node's mutex and upgrades its parent `Weak`, so one re-parent in a 10k-node tree costs 72 µs, ~82% of it in `is_root` and mutex calls. The tree state's own `actual_parents` map records exactly which nodes have a parent, so the roots-only filter can answer from it without touching node locks (a debug assertion checks it agrees with `is_root`).

### Scope Lock

**Tested mechanism:** answer the built-in roots predicate from `actual_parents` during refilter.
**Allowed changes:** `crates/src/collections/tree/stream_ext.rs` (a `roots_only` flag threaded from `transform_to_tree`, the refilter predicate evaluation).
**Forbidden in this experiment:** incremental refiltering, snapshot diff, custom predicates.
measurementPlanMarkdown:
### Measurement Plan

Focused tests: `collections::tests::grouping_tree_switching` and tree tests (`tree`), full lib in debug (the assertion compares with is_root); clippy/fmt. Bench `operator_updates` (transform-to-tree) and `tree` vs base. Pass: tree update >=2x faster; tree loads not slower.
expectedOutcomeMarkdown:
### Expected Outcome

Tree re-parent update from ~72 us to ~15-20 us (snapshot rebuild and diff remain O(n)).
